findings.old: just as letters are arranged: secrets of benefit
findings.new: as with the arrangement within letters of secrets of benefit
findings.reason: Arabic وللأعداد ... أسرار ومنافع رتبها جلت قدرته كارتيب في الحروف أسرار النفع compares the arrangement of numerical secrets/benefits with secrets of benefit within letters (في الحروف). The existing English instead makes the letters themselves the object arranged and detaches the secrets after a colon. Preserve letters as the location, without changing the source.

findings.old: Wudd merupakan istilah yang mencakup dua sisi
findings.reason: Arabic والود مشترك says that wudd is shared/common. It does not say here that wudd is a term encompassing two sides; that substitutes the later outward/inward division for this separate readable predicate. Preserve مشترك literally rather than replacing it with a contextual explanation.
